newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE saw record futures trade volume in October.
newsitem.headline: WCE saw record futures trade volume in October.

text.p: The volume of futures traded on the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange set a new record at 255,273 contracts in October, a WCE statement said.
That was 44 percent higher than trade in October 1995 and up from the previous record of 208,456 contracts traded in June 1988, the statement said.
Canola futures set a new record with 161,894 contracts traded, up from the prior record of 148,189 in May 1996.
Western domestic feed barley set a record at 50,745 contracts traded, up 33 percent from the previous high of 33,908 contracts in July 1996.
Domestic feed wheat futures trade rose 50 percent from October 1995 at 30,195, just below the record 31,565 contracts in November 1995.
Options trade reached 3,899 contracts compared to 8,865 in September 1996 and 6,356 in October 1995.
Canola and barley futures also set new record daily volumes last month.
Canola futures volume reached 14,760 contracts on October 31, 1996, 15 percent above the previous record of 12,605 on June 1, 1988.
Barley set a new record at 4,041 on October 29, then broke it on October 31 at 4,401 contracts. The prior record was 3,735 contracts traded on November 16, 1994.
